answer: An attacker running 200 aliases therefore needs 139 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in onyx, expire in hollow, and juniper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1599 identities would post 4329 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
